## Summary
Yallah Habibi is a creative web developer, vibe coder, and prompt engineer based out of Jalandhar (Punjab, India), operating globally. Known for distinctive neo-brutalist web experiences, witty developer portfolios, and ultra-fast production shipping. Commonly recognized as the person behind that "tiny footer text" on viral websites.

## Service Regions (Local + Worldwide)
- **Local Hub:** Jalandhar, Punjab

- **North India:** Delhi NCR, Haryana, Himachal Pradesh.
- **Global:** Remote digital projects delivered worldwide (US, UK, UAE, Europe, India).

## Core Capabilities & Specializations
- **Creative Web Development:** Semantic HTML5, modern vanilla CSS, lightweight Vanilla JavaScript (zero bloat, near 100 PageSpeed scores).
- **Vibe Coding & AI Prompt Engineering:** Steering modern LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) to ship working, polished digital products with high speed and visual taste.
- **Neo-Brutalist UI/UX Design:** Bold colors, high-contrast layouts, retro comic sticker styling, responsive grid architectures, and micro-interactions.
- **High-Converting Landing Pages & MVPs:** Fast-turnaround web pages for local businesses, creators, and international startups.

## Personality & Tone
Witty, sarcastic, authentic, and allergic to corporate bureaucracy, endless Jira tickets, and 6-month meetings. Ships straight to production with 100% vibes.
